fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Limited Turnaround Space; Multiple Structures
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the entrance to each detached structure with a visible address or unit identifier so responders can quickly locate the correct building.
• Keep a clear path between the main residence and each detached structure so responders can move between buildings without obstruction.
• Mark the primary driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the road in both directions.
• Keep at least one parking area clear of vehicles during emergencies to give responders a staging area near the structures.
• Identify and mark a secondary access point so responders arriving from different directions know which entry points are usable.
• Post a simple site map at the driveway entrance showing the location of each structure and available access points.
• Keep the area around each detached structure free of parked vehicles so responders can get equipment close to any building.
• If gates control any access points, keep them unlocked or install a rapid-access lock compatible with local responder tools.
